profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Supermicro
profile.summary: Self-motivated with a preference for project based work.  Works well individually or in small groups with the ability to lead or assist.  Strong interest in pattern recognition, automation, and self-sustaining systems.  Anticipating problems and proposing a variety of solutions is a forte of mine. Primarily focused on high level design (architecture and management) but can dig down and work on lower level (implementation, debugging, testing).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed and implemented the Global Service Portal: The Strategic Solutions and Global Services department’s central CRM using CentOS, KVM, MySQL, NodeJS, Socket.io, D3.js.
- Wrote userscripts (Tampermonkey) to automate filling out forms used in various service processes
- Wrote software to integrate the departments data with multiple partners: UPS Post Service Logistics, ByBox, Salesforce, EZSVS, Source Support Services 
- Developed software to automate the configuration, asset verification, testing of new servers at customer data centers during mass deployments.

positions.title: Research Internship
positions.locationName: Naval Air Station, Moffett Field, Mountain View, CA 94035
positions.description: Worked with LabVIEW, both software and hardware for the Carbon Dioxide Removal Compression System (CDRC) and Cabin Air Simulator (CAS).

positions.title: Quality Assurance Internship
positions.description: Assisted the Quality Assurance and Quality Control departments with various tasks.

positions.title: Software Engineering Internship
positions.description: Created software that maps latitude and longitude to county and postal code (Java), automated archiving of social media posts like Facebook (Java), front end GUI for displaying heatmaps on a world map (JavaScript, d3).

positions.title: Quality Assurance Internship
positions.description: Imported the QA digital-document filing system from a contractor (MasterControl) into the new in-house system using C# scripts.  Continue to do upkeep and various tasks related QA.

positions.title: Chemistry Lab Internship
positions.description: General laboratory duties included vivarium maintenance and cleaning for lab animals, setting up the laboratory for animal studies, polymer washing, and data entry.

positions.title: Summer Internship
positions.description: Designed and developed web-based user interface markups and prototypes to help define and validate requirements for a software project using html and Visual Studio.  Created virtual machine test environments using VMware.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Liberal Arts: Science, Math, and Engineering Emphasis
